purpose: Preregistered real-model Granite state-isolation check before enabling opt-in interleaving
a_source: Committed LibriSpeech fixture tests/fixtures/2086-149220-0033.wav repeated 10x by tests/fixtures/make_fixtures.py; 74.35 seconds, 3 Granite chunks, padded tail
b_generation: Decode public 16 kHz mono FLAC to PCM16 WAV with FFmpeg 4.4.2; repeat its 10.435 s PCM frame sequence exactly 7 times with Python wave, producing 73.045 s, 3 Granite chunks and a padded tail. The generated B WAV is a local ignored artifact, not committed.
workload: On CPU cores 16-23, OMP_NUM_THREADS=8, warm each server on the same short public WAV. Serial baseline: A then B. Opt-in server: submit A1, then B after A1 queue_wait, then A2 after B queue_enter so chunks interleave. Every HTTP request has a distinct id and a 600 s timeout.
pass_rule: All five HTTP requests return 200 with nonempty final hashes; serial A hash equals both fair A1 and fair A2, serial B hash equals fair B, and A hash differs from B. Each request traces exactly chunks 1,2,3. Fair B chunk 1 and fair A2 chunk 1 must occur between fair A1 chunks 1 and 2. No missing result or failed attempt is excluded. This is output-isolation evidence, not a latency distribution or proof for all audio.
new_session_rule: While fair A1 first chunk is active and before B/A2 are queued, open a fresh WS and send application ping. Require pong in <2.0 seconds and B/A2 to enter queue before A1 first chunk completes. This tests the cached backend-identity admission fix separately from output parity.
amendment_1: Before any real A/B/A run, add the fresh-session ping/pong probe during A1 chunk 1. It does not change the pinned inputs, output-equivalence rule or A/B/A chunk-order rule.
amendment_2: After the initial A/B/A pass, source commit bce8e389fd584ace2f345c8a3bc2270f134fb45b fixed the pre-load backend-identity cache and made failed/partial request outcomes persistent. The final-binary run uses the same A/B/A audio, chunk order, admission and hash rules. Initial results and their original spec remain committed; no attempt is discarded.
amendment_3: Source commit a3fd82279cd17262cb2c8398cf21fb0aff70ded6 propagates blocked streaming queue timeouts and adds historical-spec handling to the paired evaluator. This final-binary A/B/A replication keeps all pinned audio, chunk-order, hash and admission rules unchanged. The preceding fair-arm attempt was interrupted after one idle trial; its partial evidence is preserved and is not a scored result.
